$comment: Evaluation task suite. Each task states the capabilities that must ALL be held for the task to be completable. This is a static coverage suite - it checks capability presence, not runtime output quality.

tasks.name: Build a responsive landing page from a brief
Critique the visual design of an existing page
Capture the page at three viewports
Report WCAG violations on a live page
Detect unintended visual change against a baseline
Review the diff for correctness and convention
Give an evidence-backed verdict on whether the page is ready to ship
